children: Robert Kiyosaki says phrases such as “I can’t afford it,” “I’ll try,” and “the rich are greedy” reveal a scarcity mindset and can keep people poor. According to BeInCrypto, the Rich Dad Poor Dad author argued in a recent post on X that words shape how people think about money, while also outlining earned, portfolio and passive income as different tax treatments. He said he has held gold since 1971, silver since 1965, Bitcoin since 2012 and more recently Ethereum.

title: Robert Kiyosaki Says 3 Phrases Keep People Poor
